offering_description.value: eGain sells cloud software for customer service and knowledge management to businesses and government agencies. Its platform helps contact center staff find answers, automates customer self-service, and lets service teams manage digital conversations and track performance.

primary_products.value: knowledge management software; AI agent-assist tools; virtual assistants and self-service portals; digital customer engagement software; contact center analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprises with contact centers and customer support teams; B2G: Government agencies that operate public help desks and contact centers

end_markets.value: financial services; telecommunications; retail; healthcare; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud knowledge management and customer service software; service fees: Implementation, integration, and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Turns organizations’ knowledge content and interaction data into tools for service teams and their customers; service provider: Uses customers’ workflows and system requirements to configure and integrate deployments for service teams

geography_served.value: global: North America and Europe, with operations in India

specialization.value: related lines: Knowledge management, agent assistance, self-service, digital engagement, and service analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams selling to businesses and public agencies; partners / resellers: Contact center technology partners and systems integrators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: GDPR and applicable US privacy laws govern the handling of personal data in customer interactions

notes: The current scope of standalone digital engagement products is uncertain.
